results.name: test_label_values_in_codebook

results.name: test_codebook_documents_every_value

results.name: test_stance_and_tone_quotes_appear_in_raw_text
results.doc: Each stance and tone quote is found word for word in that institution's raw excerpt.

results.doc: Every ai_collaboration = yes label cites a partner-style quote found in the raw text.

results.name: test_se_quotes_appear_in_raw_text
results.doc: Each SE course stance quote is found word for word in that course's raw excerpt.

results.name: test_findings_counts_equal_csv
results.doc: Dashboard stance, tone and collaboration counts equal a direct count of coded.csv.

results.name: test_findings_totals_equal_sample
results.doc: Every chart's bars add up to the sample size (nothing dropped or double counted).

results.name: test_stance_by_level_adds_up
results.doc: Stance-by-level cross tab sums back to the overall stance counts.

results.name: test_kappa_perfect_agreement
results.doc: cohen_kappa returns 1.0 when two coders agree on everything.

results.name: test_kappa_known_value
results.doc: cohen_kappa matches a hand-computed example (po=0.5, pe=0.5 gives kappa 0).

results.name: test_kappa_textbook_example
results.doc: cohen_kappa matches the standard 50-item example (20+15 agree, kappa = 0.4).

results.name: test_keyword_rule_ignores_header
results.doc: Keyword rule reads only excerpt lines, so words in a URL or title cannot trigger it.

results.name: test_keyword_kappa_reported
results.doc: Keyword-vs-Claude agreement is computed and every disagreement is listed.
